# Next.js App Router — Type Definitions

## Where to put type definitions

| Type | Location | Example |
|---|---|---|
| Form schema and type | `app/(app)/{feature}/form.ts` | `FamilyRegisterFormSchema`, `FamilyRegisterFormType` |
| Shared form/validation primitives | `app/(core)/schema.ts` | `DisplayIdSchema`, `BirthdaySchema` |
| API request/response types | `app/api/{resource}/route.ts` (export from handler) | `PostFamilyRequest`, `GetChildrenResponse` |
| API query parameter types | `app/api/{resource}/query.ts` | `FamilyQuestFilterType` |
| DB row types | `drizzle/schema.ts` (via `$inferSelect` / `$inferInsert`) | `FamilySelect`, `FamilyInsert` |
| Component Props | Inside the component file (no export needed) | `type Props = { childId: string }` |
| Hook return / argument types | Inside the hook file (no export needed) | Inline in function signature |
| Domain types reused across features | `app/(core)/types.ts` (when shared by 3+ files) | `SortOrder`, `Pagination` |

> No global `types.d.ts`. Types live next to the code that owns them.

---

## type vs interface

Use `type` by default. `interface` is reserved for cases where declaration merging or extension is required (rare in app code).

```ts
// ✅ Use type for everything
type Props = { childId: string }
type SortOrder = "asc" | "desc"
type Context = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
type QuestSort = { column: QuestColumn; order: SortOrder }

// ⚠️ Only use interface when extending a library's interface
interface CustomTheme extends MantineTheme { /* ... */ }
```

---

## Zod schema → Type inference

Define schema with Zod, then infer the type. **Do not write the type by hand** — always infer it from the schema.

```ts
import { z } from "zod"

/** 家族登録フォームスキーマ */
export const FamilyRegisterFormSchema = z.object({
  displayId: z.string().nonempty(),
  localName: z.string().nonempty().max(10),
  parentName: z.string().nonempty(),
  parentBirthday: z.string().nonempty(),
  onlineName: z.string().nullable(),
  familyIconId: z.number(),
  familyIconColor: z.string(),
  parentIconId: z.number(),
  parentIconColor: z.string(),
})

/** 家族登録フォーム型（推論） */
export type FamilyRegisterFormType = z.infer<typeof FamilyRegisterFormSchema>
```

### Why inference

- Schema and type can never go out of sync
- Refactoring the schema automatically updates the type
- Smaller diffs on schema changes

---

## Schema composition

### Extending a base schema

```ts
// Base
export const BaseQuestFormSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().nonempty(),
  iconId: z.number(),
  details: z.array(QuestDetailScheme),
  // ... shared fields
})

// Family-specific extension
export const FamilyQuestFormSchema = BaseQuestFormSchema.extend({
  childSettings: z.array(ChildSettingSchema),
})
export type FamilyQuestFormType = z.infer<typeof FamilyQuestFormSchema>
```

### Cross-field validation with `.refine()`

```ts
export const ResetPasswordFormSchema = z.object({
  password: z.string().min(6),
  passwordConfirm: z.string().nonempty(),
})
.refine((data) => data.password === data.passwordConfirm, {
  message: "パスワードが一致しません。",
  path: ["passwordConfirm"],  // attach error to this field
})
```

### Reusable refine helper

When the same `.refine()` is applied to multiple schemas:

```ts
/** 年齢・月のバリデーションを追加する共通refine */
export const addAgeMonthRefinements = <T extends z.ZodObject<z.ZodRawShape>>(schema: T) => {
  return schema
    .refine(
      (data) => data.ageFrom == null || data.ageTo == null || data.ageFrom < data.ageTo,
      { message: "対象年齢(開始)は対象年齢(終了)以下である必要があります", path: ["ageFrom"] }
    )
    .refine(
      (data) => !(data.monthFrom != null && data.monthTo == null),
      { message: "公開終了月は必須です。", path: ["monthTo"] }
    )
}

// Apply
export const FamilyQuestFormSchema = addAgeMonthRefinements(
  BaseQuestFormSchema.extend({ childSettings: z.array(ChildSettingSchema) })
)
```

## Drizzle types

Drizzle ORM provides `$inferSelect` and `$inferInsert` to derive types from table definitions.

```ts
// drizzle/schema.ts
export const families = pgTable("families", {
  id: uuid("id").primaryKey(),
  displayId: text("display_id").notNull(),
  localName: text("local_name").notNull(),
})

// Select type (matches `SELECT * FROM families`)
export type FamilySelect = typeof families.$inferSelect

// Insert type (matches `INSERT INTO families`)
export type FamilyInsert = Omit<typeof families.$inferInsert, "id" | "createdAt" | "updatedAt">

// Update type
export type FamilyUpdate = Partial<FamilyInsert>
```

### Common derivations

```ts
// Exclude auto-managed columns from Insert
export type QuestInsert = Omit<typeof quests.$inferInsert, "id" | "createdAt" | "updatedAt">

// Exclude immutable fields from Update
export type QuestUpdate = Omit<Partial<QuestInsert>, "type">

// Composite return types
export type ChildQuest = {
  quest: QuestSelect
  details: QuestDetailSelect[]
  tags: QuestTagSelect[]
}
```

## API request/response types

### Request type (defined in `route.ts`)

```ts
// app/api/families/route.ts
import { z } from "zod"

export const PostFamilyRequestSchema = z.object({
  form: FamilyRegisterFormSchema,
})
export type PostFamilyRequest = z.infer<typeof PostFamilyRequestSchema>

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  // ...
  const data = PostFamilyRequestSchema.parse(body)
}
```

### Client uses the request type

```ts
// app/api/families/client.ts
import type { PostFamilyRequest } from "./route"

export const postFamily = async (request: PostFamilyRequest) => { /* ... */ }
```

### Response type via `Awaited<ReturnType<...>>`

```ts
// app/api/quests/family/[id]/route.ts
const fetchQuest = async ({ db, questId }) => {
  return await db.query.quests.findFirst({ where: eq(quests.id, questId) })
}

export type GetQuestResponse = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof fetchQuest>>
```

## Generics

Use generics for reusable layouts and hooks operating on a polymorphic form type.

```tsx
// Generic layout for any form type
type QuestEditLayoutProps<TForm extends Record<string, unknown>> = {
  questId?: string
  isLoading: boolean
  onSubmit: (e?: React.BaseSyntheticEvent) => Promise<void>
  tabs: TabConfig[]
  // ...
}

export const QuestEditLayout = <TForm extends Record<string, unknown>>({
  questId, isLoading, onSubmit, tabs,
}: QuestEditLayoutProps<TForm>) => {
  // ...
}

// Usage
<QuestEditLayout<FamilyQuestFormType>
  questId={familyQuestId}
  // ...
/>
```

```ts
// Generic mutation hook
const mutation = useMutation<void, unknown, AgeRewardFormType>({
  mutationFn: async (data) => await putChildAgeRewardTable(childId, data),
  // ...
})
```

---

## Type imports

Always use `import type` for types-only imports. This makes it explicit at the import site that nothing runtime is being pulled in.

```ts
// ✅ Type-only import
import type { PostFamilyRequest } from "./route"
import type { FamilyQuestFormType } from "../form"
import type { Quest } from "@/drizzle/schema"

// ❌ Don't use a runtime import for a type
import { PostFamilyRequest } from "./route"
```

---

## Constraints

- Always infer types from Zod schemas (`z.infer<>`) — never write parallel manual types
- Always use `import type` for type-only imports
- Default to `type`; use `interface` only for library extension
- Component `Props` types are local (not exported) unless reused
- DB types come from `drizzle/schema.ts` via `$inferSelect` / `$inferInsert`
